# javaabu/cms

> A complete CMS for Laravel assembled from Javaabu packages. It registers a content model with javaabu/post-types (pages at /{slug}, news with categories and tags), menu locations with javaabu/dynamic-menubuilder (header, footer), widget locations with javaabu/widgets (sidebar, footer) plus recent-posts and terms widgets, and a "Site" settings page with javaabu/settings (site name, tagline, front page, footer text). Route::cmsAdmin() puts a dashboard and every package's admin pages (post types, media, menus, widgets, settings, roles) under one prefix, name and guard; Route::cms() adds the home page and the public post type pages. Cms::navigation() is the permission-aware admin navigation. A public theme and admin layout ship in Blade and Inertia React (@javaabu/cms through javaabu/manifest). php artisan cms:install sets everything up with starter content; php artisan cms:import-v1 brings a v1 site's content over. Permissions through javaabu/permissions, any guard. Optional javaabu/translatable. English and Dhivehi, RTL.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/cms/.

## Rules

- Don't write models, migrations, controllers or CRUD views for pages, news, categories, menus or widgets: they're javaabu/post-types', dynamic-menubuilder's and widgets'. Add post types with PostTypes::register() (start from Javaabu\Cms\Content\Defaults to change a default) and remove defaults in config/cms.php.
- Register routes with Route::cmsAdmin(['guard' => ..., 'prefix' => 'admin', 'name' => 'admin.']) and Route::cms(). Call Route::cms() after the app's own routes: pages live at /{slug}. Don't also call Route::postTypesAdmin(), Route::menus(), Route::widgets(), Route::settings(), Route::mediapicker() or Route::roles() for the same prefix; turn a section off with its option (`'roles' => false`) or pass it options.
- Run php artisan cms:install (or permissions:sync), then give roles view_dashboard and the content permissions (view_/edit_/delete_/publish_{type}, view_/edit_/delete_{taxonomy}, view_menus, view_widgets, view_settings, edit_site_settings, view_media).
- Add admin links with Cms::navigation()->add(NavigationItem::make('key')->label(fn () => __('…'))->route('name.index')->group('content')->can('ability')); routes are relative to the admin name prefix.
- Read site details with Cms::siteName(), Cms::tagline(), Cms::footerText(), Cms::frontPage() or Cms::site(), not settings('site_name').
- Blade pages extend config('cms.layouts.public') / 'cms::layouts.public' (section `content`). For Inertia, resolve pages with withCmsLayouts(resolvePage(...)) from @javaabu/cms; the `cms`, `menus` and `widgets` shared props are filled on CMS routes.
- cms.sync_packages (default on) sets the views and layouts of post-types, widgets, dynamic-menubuilder, settings, mediapicker and permissions from config('cms'). Turn it off before configuring those packages' views or layouts yourself.
- Optional packages (inertiajs/inertia-laravel, javaabu/translatable) are feature-detected; go through Javaabu\Cms\Support\Translations, never translatable's classes directly.
- Upgrading from v1: php artisan migrate renames v1's tables to cms_v1_*, then php artisan cms:import-v1 [--type=v1:v2] [--taxonomy=v1:v2] [--dry-run].
- Pass every user-facing string through __() and add it to lang/dv.json. Use logical CSS (ms-, pe-, inset-inline-start) in overridden views.
